title: 排队为什么能让交接有序
source_summary: 虚构的单服务窗口教学情境：按先来后到交接令牌。不是具体芯片实现，也不宣称所有队列都使用该策略。

characters.guide: A black 2D stick figure with a hollow round head, no facial features, connected single-line body, exactly two arms and two legs, stable medium line weight and proportions. Only the current limb pose is visible; no clothing or body fill.

voice_lock: One adult Mandarin narrator, neutral standard Mandarin accent, warm mid register, clear calm delivery, measured pace, dry close recording; unchanged identity and treatment across clips.

clips.environment: Flat pure white field, black line-art queue markers and service tray; a single orange token. No written labels.
clips.composition: Wide 16:9 lateral staging: queue on left, service on right, clear negative space above, all actions inside frame.
clips.narration: 在这个例子里，先到的人，先把令牌交给窗口。

beats.action: 建立横向队列：讲解角色指向入口托盘中的橙色令牌，物体不移动。
角色走到托盘前，右手接触并握住令牌，托盘上不再出现副本。
角色持令牌停在队列旁，让观众看清持有者。

clips.environment: Flat pure white field, black line-art queue markers and service tray; a single orange token. No written labels.
clips.composition: Wide 16:9 lateral staging: queue on left, service on right, clear negative space above, all actions inside frame.

transition.reason: Preserve guide and token ownership across the cut.

clips.narration: 后到的人先等待。这样，每次交接都有明确的顺序。

beats.action: 承接前镜持有状态，角色转向右侧窗口，令牌仍在右手。
角色走向窗口，把令牌放到服务托盘，右手松开并离开。
角色退到托盘旁，令牌保持静止，以一次清楚交接结束。
